fact_text: Lucky Cement raised cement prices in the southern zone by about Rs 400 per ton, or about Rs 20 per bag.

fact_text: Cement retention prices are cited at about Rs 700 to 800 per bag, a level the analyst said gives producers a large gross margin.

fact_text: Lucky Cement has five silos at PIBTL, which the analyst described as useful export storage.

fact_text: The analyst said Lucky Cement earns strong gross margins and benefits from export sales at regional prices, which make up a large part of its volume.

fact_text: Attock Cement's seven-month volumes were mostly exports, which placed it second in the southern zone behind Lucky Cement.
